dotnet_metadata_independent_check.raw_method_token_comparison_caveat: The metadata rewrite reordered method/field tokens. Equality by raw token is not a valid semantic method comparison; mismatch is not evidence of changed behavior.
dotnet_metadata_independent_check.interpretation: RVA data preservation is verified by sizes and hashes independently of reordered tokens; each of the 251 recovered arrays is compared with its original RVA bytes. Semantic method equivalence was not established.

dotnet_metadata_repair_reported.operation: Rename duplicate nested types and fields named <>c using their metadata tokens. No method bodies intentionally changed.

limits: This audit did not execute the original EXE, DLL or PYD application code.
No authorization or time-limit logic was modified.
Section names and entropy are descriptive signals, not a complete detector for packers, virtualization, anti-tamper or runtime decryption.
Compilation and entry-point bytecode matches do not establish full application behavior equivalence.
